ترتبطوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَبِطُوا (tartabiṭū) /tar.ta.bi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# تُرْتَبَطُوا (turtabaṭū) /tur.ta.ba.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
